Home - J. Rockett Audio Designs Welcome To Rockett Audio! Shop Overdrives Signature Pedals Boosts Compressors Modulation Reverbs & Delays Power Products Replacement Parts B Stock About Resources Dealers Warranty Registration Contact Us My account Shop Overdrives Signature Pedals Boosts Compressors Modulation Reverbs & Delays Power Products Replacement Parts B Stock About Resources Dealers Warranty Registration Contact Us My account Social Studio rack compression for your pedalboard Airchild 660 Buy Now Versatility Blue Note Select Buy Now Pedals For Pros We build every pedal from the perspective of the musicians playing them. Pedals that complete your rig and are “that sound in your head”. Our pedals are built to last and meet the highest demands whether you are on the road or studio. Don’t take our word for it, with players like Jeff Beck, Billy Gibbons, Mark Lettieri, Steve Stevens and more playing our pedals we hope to inspire your playing everyday. Tone & Feel Experience gain, touch sensitivity and expression like never before with pedals classic inspired analog circuits with modern features Built Tough We know the demands a player goes through on and off stage. With solid steel construction and replaceable footswitches have confidence no matter the venue Learn More Featured Aqueous Chorus $ 229.99 HRM V2 $ 229.99 Boing Reverb $ 199.99 Archer Ikon OD $ 229.99 Archer OD $ 229.99 B Stock Airchild B Stock $ 183.20 HRM V2 B Stock $ 179.00 Dude V2 B Stock $ 159.20 Archer B Stock $ 159.20 Boing Reverb B Stock $ 119.99 iKon B Stock $ 159.20 .45 Caliber OD B Stock $ 159.20 Replacement Parts Speedswitch $ 9.99 This product has multiple variants. The options may be chosen on the product page Archer Knobs $ 4.99 Inspired by the Pros, Loved by All Now this pedal, so far, is magical. It’s exactly what I was looking for. I figured the best way to find a new pedal is to look up what guitarist you love are using. I’m basically obsessed with Snarky Puppy, and found a gear rundown from a couple of the members. Mark Lettieri talked about his board, including this pedal, which he made with J. Rockett audio designs! RockinJosh The J. Rockett Rockaway Archer. This is brilliant, and now I’m wondering why not all overdrives have a 6-band graphic EQ. This thing is absolutely brilliant. It’s still definitely an Archer at heart (which is a Klon type pedal), but the 6-band graphic EQ gives it an insane amount of versatility for tone shaping.
